name: mcp-watch-connection-closed
description: A status_watch_once whose value never satisfies its equals value waits until the host closes the connection, and the server reports the end as a tool error.
reason: The replay cannot close the connection of the application on demand. The MCP test also passes the status value through unchanged, and that value is a string, while the core.screen status of the workbench is an object (packages/workbench/core-exposure.js:334).
